news.body:
## Tomorrow, and the one thing in the folder that does not exist
- You are asking Muskan Jain about the completion printout forty-five minutes after you need it.
Your submission is at 2:45 and her counselling call is at 3:30, and the printout Delhi says is mandatory still has not arrived. She answered inside a day last time. - Email her today and ask whether the Pastel certificate will stand in its place, so you learn the answer before the counter rather than at it.
- After tomorrow you can finally answer Marie Rose.
She asked where you are in the visa process, and that question is what the extension on the EUR 53,000 is resting on. A submission receipt is the answer, and until you send it the extension exists only as an offer in a thread.
## Tonight starts at half past midnight
- The Amazon session at the LatAm fair is the one in that fair with something at stake for you.
Your Launch application is live and you sat the assessment yesterday. It is also the night before Delhi, and the McKinsey session is two nights later at the same hour. - If you only stay up once this week, stay up for McKinsey.
## Still open from yesterday
- Both Google applications closed yesterday and both still read To-do.
Google acknowledged one of them and named no role, so only you know which you actually sent.
- Good one on the coaching session: Liesbeth Van Loock, 25 November, on your Career Anchor scores.
